title: Cheap
text: Cheap. These feel terribly cheap. I figured with so many good reviews they must be good, but they just feel so cheap and thin and small. Threads are shedding all over and they’re a bit scratchy too. The only way I could imagine them holding up for a year or two is just because there are so many of them. I will be using them for nice rags, not kitchen hand towels like I had hoped.
